company.name: BrowserStack
company.shortDescription: BrowserStack is a technology-based platform that specializes in powering web and app testing such as testing iOS and Android mobile apps.
company.description: BrowserStack is a software testing platform that runs more than two million tests per day across 15 global data centers. It enables Microsoft, Twitter, Barclays, Expedia, and more than 25,000 customers to produce high-quality software quickly by transferring testing to the cloud. Its technology delivers rapid access to over 2,000 real mobile devices and browsers via a highly reliable cloud architecture that scales seamlessly as testing requirements grow. BrowserStack enables development and QA teams to move quickly while providing an exceptional client experience.

aiResearchSummary.text: BrowserStack is researching remote device infrastructure for web and app testing, as seen in titles like 'Remote device infrastructure' and 'Automation testing with remote device infrastructure.' Abstracts describe enabling developers to select and control remote devices in datacenters, stream device displays, and automate testing via SDKs. Additional work includes features for accessibility, media transfer, network status simulation, and multisession support, highlighting focus areas in remote testing, automation, and device management.
